posts.spokenScript: Most people do not have agents. They have chat with extra steps. If there is no done-condition, there is no agent — only theater. Define the artifact first: script, PR, clip, board update. Attach a finish line the agent can fail. Verify with proof: file path, test, screenshot, draft. Human-gate money, brand, and publish. Everything else can move. That is how you ship daily without drowning. Save this. One real artifact today.
